title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn to Tidy Up
summary: Today, Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona learn the joy of tidying up. After a fun playtime, they find their toys scattered everywhere! Together, they come up with a plan to make cleaning up fun and discover how nice it is to have a tidy space.
lesson: Kids learn the importance of tidying up and making it fun.

beats.beat: The friends are playing together in the colorful playroom. Toys are everywhere, making it look messy. Baby Leo smiles and asks, 'Why is our room so messy?'
